transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

I've been feeling persistently depressed, sad, and empty for a really long time now. It has been going on for about two years and three months, and I just can't seem to shake this feeling. I decided it was finally time to seek help.
During these past two years, have you experienced any periods of two months or longer where you felt completely free of these symptoms, or has the low mood been present almost every single day?

I'm not entirely sure about the exact timeline of any breaks, but the low mood has felt pretty constant over the last two years. I don't recall any memorable, long periods where I felt completely better.

latest_inference.note: Previously the candidates were [Major Depressive Disorder, Persistent Depressive Disorder]. The patient reports a duration of over two years with a constant low mood and no clear symptom-free intervals of two months or longer. This clinical presentation is highly consistent with Persistent Depressive Disorder (Dysthymia), making it the primary diagnosis over Major Depressive Disorder.
